settings.heading: Details & dosage
settings.content: Each bottle contains 120 vegetable capsules — a 60-day supply at the full serving. Serving size: 2 capsules (1000 mg NMN). Take once daily, ideally in the morning, with or without food.

settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content: β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) 1000 mg, vegetable cellulose capsule. That's it — no fillers, no magnesium stearate, no flow agents, no artificial anything. Non-GMO, gluten-free, vegan.

settings.heading: Testing & quality
settings.content: Manufactured in a cGMP facility and tested by an ISO 17025-accredited lab for purity, identity, heavy metals and microbials. A certificate of analysis is published for every lot. .

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: Free carbon-neutral shipping over $50; ships within 24 hours. Subscriptions ship automatically — skip, pause or cancel anytime. Backed by our 60-night money-back guarantee.
